results.description: Eight people, mostly pilgrims, were killed and several injured after a fire broke out at a four-storey hotel in Tarapith, Birbhum, around 5 am on Monday. Police arrested hotel owner Kalyan Paul and launched a probe into the cause of the fire and whether adequate safety measures were in place.
